name: Children's Minnesota 16 and 17 year old summer volunteers
what_you_do: Summer volunteering at a children's hospital. Teens help with the activities cart, the Child Life Zone, the sibling play area and Star Studio.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 or 17. You must be free for at least 10 weekly 3-hour weekday daytime shifts in the summer.
duration: At least 30 hours over the summer (10 weekly 3-hour shifts), weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
deadline_text: The teen page gives no application dates. Complete applications go on a summer waiting list.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form for 16 and 17 year old summer helpers. Within 2 weeks, email your shot records and a form signed by a parent to volunteer.services@childrensmn.org. Then you have a talk with staff, a class online and a fingerprint check.
notes: Spots are limited. No evening or weekend shifts. Applications missing shot records are not kept after 2 weeks. Volunteer Services: Minneapolis 612-813-6200, St. Paul 651-220-6141.
